minutes.headline: 205 Sunset Lane dock and stairs got a negative determination 4-1, over the chair's objection.
minutes.summary: The Conservation Commission met by Zoom and heard several wetland hearings. Most were continued to October 6 awaiting DEP file numbers or absent applicants. Negative determinations were issued for the St. Boniface parking lot, 10 Butterfly Lane and 205 Sunset Lane, and 441 Townsend Harbor Road was approved with a tree-size condition.

what_happened.line: The commission approved the 205 Sunset Lane stairs and dock and issued a negative determination for it, each 4-1, with the chair voting no.
The commission issued a negative determination for the St. Boniface parking lot and playground at 811 Mass Ave.
A negative determination for the 10 Butterfly Lane pool and pavilion was moved, but the vote count was not audible.
A rebuild and replanting at 441 Townsend Harbor Road was approved with a condition on the size of replacement red maples; the vote was not audible.
Most other hearings, including 30 Johnson Street and 137 Flynn Road, were continued to October 6 to await DEP file numbers.

why_it_matters: A negative determination means the work does not need a full wetlands permit, so these shoreline and wetland-area projects can proceed under the commission's conditions.
Several neighbors' projects, including 137 Flynn Road's shoreline wall, are still open and will be decided at the next meeting.
watch_next: October 6 meeting: continued hearings for 30 Johnson Street, 137 Flynn Road, 101 Pleasant Street, 16 Fire Road and 37 Pearl Street, plus the tabled review of encroachments on conservation land.

Ours could not hear several outcomes that the official minutes give.
